title: easywall core configuration
description: Configuration for the easywall-core daemon. See https://easywall-project.org/configuration

socket_path.description: Path to the Unix socket shared between easywall-core and easywall-web.

data_dir.description: Directory for persistent data (rules.json, version cache). Must be writable by root.

log_dir.description: Directory for log files (audit.log). Must be writable by root.

acceptance.description: Two-step activation settings. After applying rules, easywall waits for confirmation before committing. If not confirmed, rules are rolled back.

enabled.description: Enable the two-step activation mechanism. Strongly recommended — prevents accidental lockouts.

duration.description: Seconds to wait for confirmation before auto-rollback.

ipv6.description: What the firewall does with IPv6 traffic.

mode.description: filter — apply every rule to IPv6 as well as IPv4, and permit the ICMPv6 types IPv6 needs (the default). passthrough — accept all IPv6 before any rule; IPv6 is handled elsewhere. block — drop all IPv6 except loopback.

enabled.description: Obsolete since 2.5.0 and read only for migration: it never disabled IPv6 filtering. The table is inet, so every rule and the drop policy applied to IPv6 either way, and enabled = false removed only the ICMPv6 exemptions — leaving IPv6 filtered and broken. Both old values migrate to mode = "filter". Use mode instead.

icmp_allow_router_advertisement.description: Allow ICMPv6 Router Solicitation and Advertisement (types 133 and 134). Required for SLAAC address assignment.

icmp_allow_neighbor_advertisement.description: Allow ICMPv6 Neighbor Solicitation and Advertisement (types 135 and 136). Required for IPv6 address resolution.

docker.description: Docker coexistence settings. easywall uses its own nftables table (inet easywall) and does not touch Docker's chains.

enabled.description: Auto-detect Docker bridge interfaces and whitelist their networks.

allow_bridge_networks.description: Automatically add ACCEPT rules for detected Docker bridge networks.

custom_networks.description: Additional networks to whitelist (CIDR notation). Useful for custom Docker networks not auto-detected.

routing.description: What crosses the forward chain — traffic this host passes on rather than receives. The chain drops by default and a drop there is final, so a host that routes has to say so here.

mode.description: closed: pass nothing on beyond what Docker coexistence allows. networks: also pass on the networks listed below, in either direction. open: leave routed traffic alone entirely.

networks.description: Networks that may be routed (CIDR notation). Read only when mode is "networks". Docker networks cross regardless of the mode and do not belong here.

firewall.description: Protection modules. All filters are applied via nftables directly — no subprocess, no injection risk.

ssh_brute_force.description: Enable SSH brute-force prevention. Rate-limits new SSH connections, counted separately for each source address, to ssh_brute_force_connection_limit per minute.

ssh_brute_force_connection_limit.description: New SSH connections per minute allowed from one source address before the rest are dropped.

ssh_brute_force_log_limit.description: Maximum log entries per minute for SSH brute-force drops.

icmp_flood.description: Enable ICMP flood prevention. Rate-limits echo requests — ICMP type 8 and ICMPv6 type 128 — counted separately for each source address.

icmp_flood_connection_limit.description: Echo requests per second allowed from one source address.

icmp_flood_log_limit.description: Maximum log entries per minute for ICMP flood drops.

syn_flood.description: Enable SYN flood prevention. Rate-limits new TCP connections, counted separately for each source address.

syn_flood_limit.description: New TCP connections per second allowed from one source address.

port_scan.description: Enable port scan detection. Drops NULL, FIN, XMAS, and other scan probe packets.

drop_invalid_packets.description: Drop packets in an invalid connection tracking state (ct state invalid).

drop_fragments.description: Drop IP-fragmented packets. May break legitimate large-MTU traffic.

bogon_filter.description: Drop packets from RFC-1918 private addresses arriving on external interfaces (bogon filter).

connection_limit_per_ip.description: Limit maximum simultaneous connections per source IP.

connection_limit_max.description: Maximum simultaneous connections allowed per source IP.

tcp_rst_flood.description: Enable TCP RST flood prevention. Rate-limits RST packets per source IP.

tcp_rst_flood_log.description: Log dropped TCP RST flood packets.

tcp_rst_flood_limit.description: Inbound TCP RST packets per second allowed from one source address.

log_blocked_connections.description: Log all packets dropped by the final DROP policy.

log_blocked_connections_limit.description: Maximum log entries per minute for general blocked connections.

log_blacklist_connections.description: Log packets dropped by the IP blacklist.

log_blacklist_connections_limit.description: Maximum log entries per minute for blacklisted connections.
